description: This Java class 'KafkaTbTransportQueueFactory' implements the 'TbTransportQueueFactory' interface to create Kafka-based message producers and consumers for various transport-related messages within the Thingsboard platform. It manages Kafka topics, producers, consumers, and admin resources, and is conditionally loaded based on specific configuration properties.

classes.name: KafkaTbTransportQueueFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating Kafka-based message producers, consumers, and request templates for transport-related messaging in Thingsboard.

methods.name: createTransportApiRequestTemplate
methods.description: Creates a request-response template for Transport API requests and responses using Kafka.

methods.name: createRuleEngineMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka producer for ToRuleEngineMsg messages.

methods.name: createTbCoreMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka producer for ToCoreMsg messages.

methods.name: createTbCoreNotificationsMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka producer for ToCoreNotificationMsg messages.

methods.name: createTransportNotificationsConsumer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka consumer for ToTransportMsg notifications.

methods.name: createToUsageStatsServiceMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka producer for ToUsageStatsServiceMsg messages.

methods.name: createHousekeeperMsgProducer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka producer for ToHousekeeperServiceMsg messages.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up Kafka admin resources on shutdown.
